issue_context.title: Entities created with switch_as_x don't have correct name when switches have has_entity_name: True and name: null
issue_context.body:
### The problem

With zwave_js I added a new light switch device. 

In core.entity_registry I see:

        "device_id": "5a8cd2a1a34855c9d31bebe389a3085d",
        "entity_id": "switch.kitchen_sink_2_light",
        "has_entity_name": true,
        "name": null,
        "original_name": "",
        "platform": "zwave_js",


I changed its type from switch to light.
In core.entity_registry I see:

        "device_id": "5a8cd2a1a34855c9d31bebe389a3085d",
        "entity_id": "light.kitchen_sink_2_light",
        "has_entity_name": false,
        "name": null,
        "original_name": "kitchen_sink_2_light",
        "platform": "switch_as_x",


In core.device_registry I see:

        "id": "5a8cd2a1a34855c9d31bebe389a3085d",
        "name": "Kitchen Sink 2 Light",

In the frontend the name of the light.kitchen_sink_2_light appears as kitchen_sink_2_light instead of Kitchen Sink 2 Light.

I believe the issue is with has_entity_name: True and name: null

https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#has_entity_name-true-mandatory-for-new-integrations seems relevant

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2023.3.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

switch_as_x

review_comments: Not really, `switch_as_x` config entries are hidden from the user
We should default to name from the other entity and not config entry title ?
I think we should allow setting the config entry title to `None`, it's very unfortunate that we have two sources of truth here.

shouldn't the entity registry entry of the wrapped entity always be the source of truth for this entity ? 

self._name = wrapped_entry.original_name
self._has_entity_name = wrapped_entry.has_entity_name
should it not be `self._name = wrapped_entry.name or wrapped_entry.original_name`?
